# Ordora

> Ordora is a digital-menu and online-ordering platform for restaurants, cafes, dessert shops, and cake shops. A restaurant gets its own public menu page at a clean link (for example /restaurant?r=your-slug), which guests open from a link or QR code in a mobile browser — no app download, no guest account. Guests browse the menu, add items to a cart, and send an order for pickup or delivery; orders appear in the restaurant dashboard and can be shared through WhatsApp. Ordora charges one flat monthly subscription and takes no commission on orders.

## What Ordora is

- [Ordora home](https://ordora.site/): Digital menu and simpler ordering for independent restaurants.
- [Features](https://ordora.site/features): Digital menu, QR code menu, online ordering, WhatsApp ordering, restaurant dashboard, order management, table bookings, analytics.
- [How it works](https://ordora.site/how-it-works): Create the restaurant page, share the menu link or QR code, receive orders in the dashboard.
- [Pricing](https://ordora.site/pricing): One monthly plan. The current price is shown on the pricing page; it was $4.99 per month when this file was written (October 2026).
- [FAQ](https://ordora.site/faq): Common questions about apps, commissions, ordering, branding, and starting.
- [About Ordora](https://ordora.site/ordora-vs-menux): What Ordora is, its design, and its benefits.

## Who it is for

- [Restaurants](https://ordora.site/for-restaurants): A full digital menu with online ordering.
- [Cafes](https://ordora.site/for-cafes): A QR menu and online ordering for cafes.
- [Dessert shops](https://ordora.site/for-dessert-shops): An online menu for dessert shops.
- [Cake shops](https://ordora.site/for-cake-shops): A digital menu with pre-orders for cake shops.
- [Home food businesses](https://ordora.site/for-home-businesses): A digital menu and online ordering for home kitchens, bakeries, and dessert makers.

## Key features

- Public menu page per restaurant at /restaurant?r=<slug>, with logo, cover carousel, opening-hours badge, and item photos.
- Menu management: categories, items, prices, images, availability, popular badge, and position ordering.
- Item details a restaurant can set: calories, prep time, allergen note, badge (best seller, new, spicy, chef's pick, vegetarian), and a previous price shown struck through with a "save" amount.
- Cart with pickup or delivery, delivery fee, and a free-delivery progress bar when the restaurant sets a free-delivery threshold.
- Optional promo banner shown on the menu only when the restaurant sets promo text.
- Table bookings with confirmation or cancellation, and a public order-tracking page by order code.
- Share link and copy link per menu; a Google Maps link built from the restaurant's real name and address.
- Dashboard analytics: orders, revenue, and top items.
- No commission on orders. No card-payment gateway in this plan.

## Pricing

- Ordora: one plan, currently $4.99 per month, and online ordering is included in that plan. No commission is taken from a restaurant's orders.
- A free trial is offered; the pricing page and signup page state its current terms (7 days, no card at signup, when this file was written in October 2026).
- Ordora does not include a booking app, a promotions app, multi-branch management, or multiple admin roles in this plan.

## Try it

- [Contact](https://ordora.site/contact): Request your own restaurant page.

## ملخص بالعربية

Ordora منصة منيو رقمي وطلب أونلاين للمطاعم والمقاهي ومحلات الحلويات والكيك، بواجهة عربية. يحصل كل مطعم على صفحة قائمة عامة برابط ورمز QR يفتحها الضيوف من المتصفح دون تحميل تطبيق، ويطلبون استلامًا أو توصيلًا، وتظهر الطلبات في لوحة تحكم المطعم مع ملخصات عبر واتساب. اشتراك شهري واحد ثابت: 4.99$ شهريًا، مع تجربة مجانية لمدة 7 أيام بدون بطاقة عند التسجيل، وبدون عمولة على الطلبات.
